title: 6.3 Where Are You Going?
unit_outcome: Name places in town and ways to travel, say where you are going and where places are, give and follow directions, and use bus and train times in Spanish.
goal: Ask and say where people are going: ¿Adónde va ella? Ella va a la biblioteca.
grammar_function: ¿Adónde + ir? Ir + a/al + place (+ en + vehicle).
speaking_outcome: Ask and say where people are going: ¿Adónde va ella? Ella va a la biblioteca.
